reviews.review:
I bought Anacrusis for less than $2 and I still would not recommend it even at that price.

I'm sure this game started with the best of intentions but ultimately what you're paying for here is an unfinished product. It's short a couple of art and animation passes and there was even a point where the screen just goes white because it's missing whatever cutscene or sequence was meant to play there.

Even quality issues aside it has no new ideas of its own that move the genre forward, in fact it's inferior to the game it's based on in pretty much every way.

This game should have a very clear "EARLY ACCESS" sign hanging on it given the state it's in however I can't help think the developer is trying to re-coup any money it can just off the value of the fact it says"From the lead for Left 4 Dead and L4D2" on the store page regardless of the final quality (or lack thereof) of the product.

This game can be fun if you get it at a steep discount and play with friends on hard, but as others have mentioned the worst offense of this game is just doesn't "feel" good to play. If you are looking for a cooperative zombie shooter there are better options.

Similar to l4d but feels underwhelming. Understandably, the game is still in development but to have voice acted characters who barely speak to each other other than to holler enemy names at you makes the game feel hollow. Pair this with the unsatisfying gunplay and lack of rhythm to each section that makes l4d so satisfying and you've got a game that perhaps wasn't ready for release outside of dedicated testing groups.
